Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.periodictable

Class ImageFactory

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.periodictable.ImageFactory
public class ImageFactory extends Object
Generates the images for PeriodicTable3D. The images are written to tempfiles, from where the images can be read by ImagePanels.
